products.name: Recraft
products.note: Vector image generation; brand consistency; commercial design; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Recraft is an AI-powered design platform aimed at designers, creatives, sellers, and teams. The company describes itself as a top-ranked text-to-image model and design platform, offering tools for photorealism, vector generation, custom styles, and mockups. Users can generate and edit images, vectors, and mockups using Recraft's own models alongside other frontier models.

The platform's core features include the ability to create custom styles by supplying existing images, which Recraft converts into reusable and editable style templates for brand consistency. Vector image generation and commercial design use cases are noted as particular strengths, and the product is recorded as UK-hosted.

The site's held facts list one tracked product, also called Recraft, under the Image and Graphic Design category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the company in the available data.
